introText: Hi! I'm <highlighted>Michał Pietrykowski</highlighted>, a <highlighted>full stack developer</highlighted> from <highlighted>Wrocław, Poland</highlighted>, with 4 years of commercial experience in <highlighted>Python</highlighted> and <highlighted>TypeScript</highlighted>. It all started in secondary school with <highlighted>QBASIC</highlighted> text adventures. These days I spend most of my time building LLM-based products and <highlighted>AI agents</highlighted> in LangChain.
academicText: I earned my engineering degree in <highlighted>IT Automation Systems</highlighted> at <highlighted>Wrocław University of Science and Technology</highlighted> with a grade of 5.0, and I'm now doing a part-time master's in <highlighted>Computer Science</highlighted> at WSB Merito University.
skillText: At work I care most about <highlighted>code review</highlighted> and <highlighted>automated tests</highlighted>. I use AI-assisted development every day, with <highlighted>Claude Code</highlighted> and MCP, but every decision and every pull request still goes through me. After hours I build <highlighted>VELMOIS</highlighted>, an online store for our moissanite jewelry brand, which I host on my own server.
hobbyText: Outside of code you'll find me reading <highlighted>Asimov</highlighted>, practicing the <highlighted>Japanese tea ceremony</highlighted> over a bowl of matcha, or saving <highlighted>Night City</highlighted> in Cyberpunk 2077 once again.

experienceItems.title: Full Stack Developer (AI)
experienceItems.description: Main author of the AI assistant in STRUCTURA, a multi-tenant SaaS where companies define their own data schemas and an LLM fills them with data from documents, Gmail, OwnCloud and Google Calendar.
highlights: Built the chat from scratch in Next.js and LangChain, with streaming, threaded history and links to database records.
Extended the assistant so that anything available in the UI can also be done through chat, from searching and editing records and managing schemas to uploading documents and running LLM extraction.

The agent never saves data on its own. Every change is shown to the user as a proposal and runs in a transaction, with permission checks, only after approval. Its tools are generated from each customer's schemas, so they work for any configuration.
Added full-text search in PostgreSQL with pg_trgm indexes and Polish characters, and passed documents (PDF, images, DOCX) to the model inside the agent loop through middleware.

Built a Chrome extension (Manifest V3) that reads web pages and fills in forms with data from the system, also in React apps, always after the user confirms. Added Auth0 login with PKCE and around 195 tests in Vitest and Testing Library.
Moved the agent from SSE to Socket.IO, so it can call tools in the user's browser in the middle of a response and stop generating on the server when the user cancels.

experienceItems.title: Full Stack Developer
experienceItems.description: Developing the IRMATIC CMS and the apps running on IRMATIC medicine cabinets and smart lockers.
highlights: Leading the integration of IRMATIC devices with the AMMS hospital system, working directly with Asseco and hospital staff.
Front end in Vue.js, Quasar and TypeScript, back end in Flask, SQLAlchemy and PostgreSQL.
Writing tests in Pytest and deploying with Docker on AWS, where the infrastructure is managed in Terraform.

experienceItems.title: Full Stack Developer
highlights: Built REST APIs and microservices in Django, Django REST Framework and FastAPI, with React on the front end.
Wrote Airflow DAGs for data processing and prepared documentation for moving from on-premise to AWS.
Maintained CI/CD pipelines in Jenkins and test suites in Pytest.

experienceItems.title: Software Engineer Intern & QA Automation Intern
highlights: Maintained the Dolby Access desktop app in C# and .NET, fixing bugs and adding features, with xUnit tests.
Earlier, as a QA intern, built Python test automation in Pytest, including a Raspberry Pi USB Gadget package and a Page Object Model, and helped with regression testing.

futureText1: Right now I'm focused on <highlighted>AI agents</highlighted> that do real work safely: tools generated from data, human approval before every change, and tests that catch regressions before users do.
futureText2: Next on my list are launching sales at <highlighted>VELMOIS</highlighted> and finishing my <highlighted>master's degree</highlighted> in early 2027. I'd also like to share more of what I learn, through open source and maybe a tech blog.
futureText3: I work fully remote on a B2B contract. If you're looking for a full stack developer with AI experience, or just want to talk about <highlighted>sci-fi</highlighted> or the best <highlighted>ramen, sushi and tea spots in Wrocław</highlighted>, send me a message!
